title: Negativland, Culture Jamming, and the Art of Making Something New
summary: This article from the Internet Archive explores Negativland, a pioneering art collective known for culture jamming through sample-based collage works, examining their innovative approach to creating new art by transforming existing media and challenging corporate messages.
problem_solved: It addresses how artists can create powerful social commentary by transforming and subverting existing media rather than starting from scratch.
why_valuable: The article provides insight into a radical artistic methodology that challenges copyright norms while serving as a potent form of media criticism and cultural intervention.
